description: This file defines the internal sealed class InvokableMethodProxyBase within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. It models a proxy base for an invokable method, including its characteristics such as whether it is an extension, its base type, associated alias components, and invokable base types for different return types. The class is primarily involved in code generation processes related to Orleans grains.

classes.name: InvokableMethodProxyBase
classes.description: Models a proxy base for an invokable method, encapsulating details such as the proxy type, extension status, alias components, and mappings of invokable base types for return types, used in Orleans code generation.

methods.name: InvokableMethodProxyBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the proxy base with a code generator, a descriptor key, and a dictionary of invokable base types.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines equality with another InvokableMethodProxyBase instance based on the Key property.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the key associated with this proxy base.
